page.layout: One page of text. Hebrew head entry with Latin commentary, then successive entries, each a Hebrew word with Latin gloss and biblical references. No margin notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: נוּף Stillavit, Perstillavit, de Liquidis: Suffivit, Suffumigavit, de Aridis. Præterit. נפתי משכב Perstillavi cubile meum myrrha, &c. Proverb.7.v.17, Pih. נופּ Agitavit: Fut. יְנוֹף Agitabit manum suam, Jesa.10.v.32. Hiph. הניף Stillavit, Agitavit, Ventilavit. Sæpè autem dicitur de speciali sacrificiorum quorundam oblatione, quæ fiebat agitatione versus Orientem & Occidentem, Meridiem & Septentrionem, ad offendendum, in quatuor mundi partibus debere sacrificia ad laudem nominis divini offerri, ut Veteres Hebræorum Sapientes tradiderunt, Cod. Talmud. Menachoth.cap.5.fol.61.62. & Cod. Succa,cap.3. fol.37. & inde R.Sal.Exod.29.24. Interdum, Agitare fursum, unde Chaldæus per אֵרִים Elevare, reddit. Inde Synecdochicè pro Offerre fumitur: Præterit. הניף תנופת זהב Obtulit quisque oblationem auri Domino, Exod.35.v.22. הניף Agitavit Aaron, Agitando & ventilando obtulit, Lev.9.21. והנפתם אותם Et agitabis ea, Exod.29.24. Futur. תניף גשם נדבות תניף Pluviam liberalissimam stillabis, Psal. 68.v.10. Hoph. Præter. הונף אשר Quod agitatum est, Exod.29.27.
נוֹף m. Tractus, Clima, Psal.48.3. Est & Proprium nomen urbis Noph: quæ Memphis esse creditur, Jesa.19.13. & aliàs etiam Moph appellatur, Hos.9.6. Plurale apud Rabbinos, נופות Tractus, Climata terræ.
נֹפֶת f. Destillatio, Psalm.19.11. Synecdochicè Favus, à Stillando, Prov.5.3. & 24.13. Cant.4.11.

נְפַת f. Agitatio: Cribrum, juxta Hebræos veteres, ab Agitatione sic dictum: Constr. בנפת שוא Agitatione vanitatis, Jesa.30.28. id est, Donec in vanum & nihilum abeant: Item, Tractus, 1.Reg.4.11. לנפת Cum tractu, Jos. 12.23. Plural. ובנפות Et in tractibus, Jos.11.2.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing is light and partly unclear at this scan resolution; several Hebrew forms (e.g. in the first entry, the Hiphil and Hophal forms, and the plural forms) are transcribed from the visible letters and may carry pointing errors. Running head "נו" at top centre is doubtful as to its exact letters. Latin abbreviations and references are kept as printed; "Jesa", "Jos" and "Hos" follow the printed "Jefa", "Jof" and "Hof" with the i/j convention applied. Some Greek-free Hebrew marks in the first entry are marked as reading, not certain.
